title: Release executable is launched from the wrong directory
root_cause: The release build writes its executable under build-output/release, but the workflow tries to launch it from target/release. The shell cannot find the executable at that path and exits with code 127.

relevant_evidence.why: The release build completes before the shell reports the missing executable.
The build target directory differs from the executable path.
The package defines the lovage-inspect executable name.
